description.text: The seventh expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released on 27 August 2021 with 237 cards, numbered to 203 with secret rares beyond. It brought back the Dragon type, led by Rayquaza VMAX and the Gigantamax Duraludon VMAX with Dragonite V and Noivern V, and gave every one of Eevee's evolutions a Pokémon V or Pokémon VMAX card: 18 Pokémon V and 15 Pokémon VMAX in all. It also has more Single Strike and Rapid Strike cards and a new Special Energy.
